title: Ada and the Autopsy
premise: Elodie Sandoval, an insurance investigator whose photographic memory has quietly exposed three staged 'accidents,' is summoned to the coastal town of Marrow Bay when a drowned woman is found wearing clothes stolen from Elodie's own apartment — including a dress she hasn't worn since her mother's funeral. The dead woman, Ada Voss, turns out to be a former nurse at the sanatorium where Elodie's mother once worked, and her death mirrors a drowning ruled accidental in 1994. As Elodie's investigation collides with the town's most powerful family, whose patriarch built his fortune on the sanatorium's buried malpractice, she discovers her own memories have been curated by someone who knew exactly what she could remember. The killer is the family's aging matriarch's caretaker — Ada's estranged daughter — who has spent thirty years protecting her mother's complicity, and Elodie must choose between exposing the truth and preserving the last living memory of her own mother, ending with Elodie testifying at trial while finally reclaiming the dress, and her past, as her own.
about_author: E. M. Halloran is the pen name of a former claims adjuster from the Pacific Northwest who spent a decade reading the fine print of other people's tragedies. Ada and the Autopsy is their third novel, following two well-reviewed mysteries praised for their uncanny attention to detail.
